title: Economy and dependence: bananas, copper and oil
goal: I can describe how US companies, single exports and loans created dependence, using relative clauses with a preposition.
grammar: relative clauses with prepositions and el que

items: I can name what US companies did in Latin America.
I can say what a country depended on.
I can say what dependency theory argued.
I can use *del que*, *con los que* and *a los que*.
I can say what a country depended on using *del que* and *con los que*.
I can say what US companies did in Latin America.
I can name the products that Latin American economies depended on.
I can explain what dependency theory argued.
I can say what the critics of that theory said.
